description: Take one of the developer's own Caps down. It stops working the moment this returns: calls get a 404 (cap_delisted) and it disappears from the store. Nothing is deleted — price versions, reviews and earnings stay, and the public page stays up marked as delisted so existing links don't break. Confirm with the user before calling: anyone using it loses access immediately. relist_cap puts it back with no new review. Needs the developer's Qumge key.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: delist_cap
